verdict.rationale: Shopify POS has developer reference documentation for POS UI extensions, covering target APIs, the CLI and direct GraphQL Admin API access. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, such as an in-browser explorer, playground or try-it console. A static API reference is only adjacent to this story, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
